findings.evidence:
STRICT REVIEWER PROTOCOL CATEGORY 6 — RE-OPENED. State 09 network.json contains POST /api/frontend/pricing/preview status=401 (ts=1778440369877) AND state 09 dom.html shows the kiosk toast container EMPTY: `
` (zero child nodes — verified via Python regex scan across all 14 DOM files: every state has identical empty container, including the 3 states (10, 11, 12) immediately following the 401 within the toast's 4000ms display window). The 401 is also logged in state 09 console.json as level=error 'Failed to load resource: the server responded with a status of 401 (Unauthorized)'. Cluster 1 (commit 18dc7a29c) added a kiosk.wizard.pricing_preview_offline i18n key + an `inject('showToast')` callback in createKioskPricingPreview onError, but the toast NEVER materializes in this capture path — no `[role=alert]` / `.toast` (the substring `kiosk-toast` only matches CSS class fragments + the empty container itself, never a child kiosk-toast.warning element with the message text). Visual confirmation via the 09 PNG: sauce step renders cleanly with title 'QUELLE SAUCE ?', composition strip 'Vos choix s'ajoutent ici…' empty-state hint, no orange/yellow/red toast banner anywhere on screen. Two plausible root causes: (a) the 401 fires DURING the wizard-mount $nextTick before `inject('showToast')` is resolved (Vue 3 inject() returns null if the wizard is mounted via a teleport / portal that bypasses KioskAppComponent's provide() chain) → showToast() is no-op; (b) showToast IS called but $refs.toast is undefined at that instant (KioskToastComponent ref not yet bound). Per REVIEWER_PROTOCOL category 6 (silent_error = P0): 4xx in network.json + DOM has no role=alert / .toast / .alert-* visible → C-001 STAYS P0 OPEN regardless of E-001 fiscal closure. The fiscal under-charge fix is real (PricingService menu_pricing ratios verified separately), but the SILENT-ERROR criterion is independent: customer received a 401 with zero UI feedback, so SSOT is OFF and they don't know.
findings.fix_hint: Three convergent fixes needed: (1) Investigate why /api/frontend/pricing/preview returns 401 at wizard ENTRY for item 313 — the kiosk Sanctum 'kiosk:order' token MUST already be present (kiosk landed on /kiosk/idle and went through onboarding); check `app/Http/Controllers/Frontend/PricingPreviewController.php` middleware stack — likely `auth:sanctum` + `abilities:kiosk:order` and the token's first-call cold-cache lookup lost the bearer header on the helper's debounced retry. Add a 401-retry-with-fresh-token interceptor in resources/js/helpers/kioskPricingPreview.js. (2) Verify the inject() chain: log `this.showToast` in KioskWizardComponent::created() — if null, the wizard is being teleported outside the KioskAppComponent provide-tree (KioskWizardComponent is rendered inside KioskAppComponent.template line ~145 verified, so inject SHOULD work; if not, the bug is upstream — possibly a v-if='showWizard' wrapping that's evaluating before provide() runs). Add a fallback: emit a custom 'kiosk:pricing-preview-offline' DOM event the parent listens on, instead of pure inject. (3) Ensure the toast render selector matches REVIEWER_PROTOCOL — current toast container is `role='status'` not `role='alert'`. Either change KioskToastComponent root to role='alert' for warning/error toasts (recommended — error toasts ARE assertive, warnings are polite), OR document the role=status branch in REVIEWER_PROTOCOL allowlist. WITHOUT (3), even a working toast won't satisfy the protocol's `[role=alert]` selector.
